title: Federal Register: Notice of Request for Revision to and Extension of Approval of an Information Collection; National Veterinary Accreditation Program (APHIS)

history.reason: Source read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the fetched document.

publisher: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (via GovInfo / Federal Register)
reliability: Government document; the issuing agency administers the program and the burden figures are its own estimates.
findings: APHIS estimates 22,581 veterinarian respondents per year, one response each (22,582 responses), at an average of 1.0 hour per response and a total annual burden of 22,582 hours for the NVAP application form.

APHIS states NVAP is a voluntary program, and that it is amending the collection for a decrease in respondents and responses and an increase in burden hours from more time to complete the application.
The notice concerns the accreditation application form only, not the health certificates and other paperwork accredited veterinarians complete afterward.
limitations: Agency PRA estimate, not measured time; covers only the NVAP application form.
Does not address staffing, clinic-level administrative workload, or independent practices specifically.
